acceptanceCriteria: A1: Record the current IncrementalMerkle call graph and establish whether it can influence a protected governance decision; no production caller or decision-evidence binding may be invented.
A2: Do not reuse a digest solely from size and mtime; same-length content changed with restored mtime must be reread and produce the correct digest, or the result must be explicitly unknown.
A3: Cover replacement, deletion, rename, and file-to-directory type changes with deterministic, fail-closed behavior and preserve path isolation.
A4: A detectable content-identity change during a read must return an explicit error rather than silently reusing or claiming a stable digest.

A5: Preserve repository identity, authorization boundaries, evidence semantics, and exit behavior; do not expand IncrementalMerkle into a production caller or make a performance claim in this Work Item.
goal: Validate the trust boundary of IncrementalMerkle before any future incremental computation is considered.
intent: The existing cache hint uses size and mtime, which cannot prove content identity. Preserve Calibrated Human-Agent Trust by failing closed or re-reading when content stability is not proven, while confirming whether the helper can affect protected decisions.
outOfScope: All crates and production governance call paths outside crates/cockpit-git/src/lib.rs.
WI-698 observation context, WI-647 status history scan, WI-648 verification wait, WI-685 status fact reuse, and all other agents' worktrees, branches, pull requests, and evidence.
Expanding IncrementalMerkle into a production caller, adding filesystem notifications or cross-request caches, changing evidence format, or claiming performance benefit.
P3 resident MCP cache, in-process Git, PGO, release publication, global configuration, and historical evidence rewriting.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The current call graph shows IncrementalMerkle is not used by a protected governance decision, or identifies the exact protected caller before any implementation change.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Search the current repository call graph, inspect the relevant crate tests, and retain the result in the Work Item evidence and tri-language report.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A same-length content change with restored mtime is reread and yields the new digest, or returns explicit unknown rather than reusing the old digest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run a focused cockpit-git test that changes content, restores the original mtime, refreshes, and compares the root digest.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Replacement, deletion, rename, and file-to-directory changes are handled deterministically and fail closed when the declared path is no longer a regular file.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Add and run focused cockpit-git tests covering each filesystem transition and retain the test receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: A detectable metadata change across a read returns an explicit content-identity error and never silently claims a stable digest.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Exercise the before/after metadata stability guard with a deterministic test seam and retain the focused test receipt.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The audit and implementation remain bound to this repository, Work Item, declared paths, and current observation; no other agent tree or evidence is touched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the governance integrity gate, inspect changed paths and Work Item bindings, and retain the isolation evidence.
